title: V2G Configuration
description: Pick the network interfaces on the charging link, save, then start. SLAC, SDP and every V2G message between the vehicle and the charger appear as they cross the link. Live capture needs a one-time grant on the machine running the agent; a start without it stops with the command to run in the log. Decoding a pcap file needs no privileges at all.

interfaces.title: Interfaces
interfaces.description: Links to capture, in parallel. Each is a branch under the Prefix source. Leave empty when using Replay PCAP File.

interface.title: Interface
interface.description: Network interface that sees the charging link (eth0, en0, enp3s0, ...): a tap, a bridge, or the powerline modem's Ethernet side. Choose from the machine running the agent, or type a name.

name.title: Name
name.description: Names this interface's branch in the signal tree. Defaults to the interface name. Letters, digits, space, '_' and '-' only. Every entry shares the Prefix source, so each name must be unique.

tls_keylog.title: TLS Key Log File
tls_keylog.description: Optional. A key log file (NSS key log format) that the charger or vehicle under test writes its TLS session secrets to. Sessions under TLS whose secrets it holds are decoded like cleartext ones. A live capture follows the file as it grows, so it may be created after the start. Applies to live capture and to Replay PCAP File. Secrets the endpoint sends on the link itself need no file.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.description: Settings that apply to every interface, and replaying a capture file instead.

prefix.title: Prefix
prefix.description: Trace source the rows land under: '<prefix>/<name>/v2gtp', '<prefix>/<name>/CurrentDemandReq', ...

promiscuous.title: Promiscuous Mode
promiscuous.description: Receive frames addressed to other stations. A tap or bridge on a charging link carries the vehicle's and the charger's unicast traffic, which the interface drops without it. Turn off only when this machine is itself the vehicle or the charger.

replay_pcap.title: Replay PCAP File
replay_pcap.description: Decode a .pcap/.pcapng file, optionally gzip or zstd compressed, instead of capturing live. This path opens no capture handle and needs no privileges, so it works on any machine; use it to analyze a capture someone sent you. Plays at the capture's original pace with timestamps shifted to start now. When set, the Interfaces list is ignored and the extension exits once the replay finishes.
